matchstick.title: Balance by numeric difference and single‑stick transformation
matchstick.principle: Compute the integer values of both sides, find the numeric difference, and look for a single‑stick move that changes a numeral or operator by exactly that amount.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is false and you need to adjust the numeric values, first calculate the difference and then search for a single‑stick transformation that accounts for that difference.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick arbitrarily without checking if the resulting numeric values match, e.g., changing 'I' to 'V' without balancing the equation.

matchstick.title: Convert V to X to add 5
matchstick.principle: If the numeric imbalance is exactly 5 and a V appears, relocate one of V’s diagonal sticks to cross the other, turning V into X (adds 5).
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by 5 and a V can be turned into an X without breaking other characters.
matchstick.example: Turning a V into an X by moving a diagonal stick but leaving the original V incomplete.

matchstick.title: Swap I and V in IV to make VI (adds 2)
matchstick.principle: If the imbalance is exactly 2 and the pattern IV appears, move the vertical stick of the I onto the V to form VI (adds 2).
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by 2 and you have an IV that can be changed to VI by moving the I’s vertical stick.
matchstick.example: Moving the vertical stick from I in 'IV' to V, resulting in an invalid 'V' and missing I.

matchstick.title: Change + to - and add I
matchstick.principle: If a plus sign is present and the numeric imbalance can be corrected by decreasing the right‑hand side, move the vertical stick from the plus sign to form an I (or part of IV) and thereby turn the plus into a minus sign.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a plus sign exists and the equation can be fixed by reducing the RHS by 1 or 4, relocate its vertical stick to create a new I (or IV) while converting '+' to '-'.
matchstick.example: Changing '+' to '-' by removing its vertical stick but not using that stick to form a new numeral, leaving the stick unused.

matchstick.title: Transfer I stick between numerals
matchstick.principle: When the equation is off by 1 and there are isolated I’s, relocate a vertical stick from one I to another numeral, ensuring both source and destination remain valid.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the numeric difference is 1 and you have at least one I that can donate its vertical stick without becoming invalid.
matchstick.example: Taking a vertical stick from an isolated I and attaching it to a numeral, but forgetting to adjust the source I, resulting in an invalid numeral.

matchstick.title: Preserve equality sign; never move its sticks
matchstick.principle: Never relocate any matchsticks that belong to the '=' sign; altering it would break the equality operator.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Always; the equality sign must remain unchanged throughout the transformation.
matchstick.example: Moving a horizontal stick from the '=' sign to another character, breaking the equality operator.

matchstick.title: Change - to = by adding a horizontal stick from a numeral
matchstick.principle: If a minus sign appears and the numeric imbalance is large, move a horizontal stick from a numeral onto the minus sign to turn it into an equals sign.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a '-' is present and the equation requires the '-' to become '=', typically to increase the left side or decrease the right side by the value of a horizontal stick.
matchstick.example: Adding a horizontal stick to a '-' to make '=', but removing the stick from a numeral and leaving that numeral invalid.

matchstick.title: Relocate minus sign to a different position
matchstick.principle: When a minus sign is present, consider moving its single horizontal stick to a new location in the equation to change the subtraction target or operator.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation contains a '-' and moving that horizontal stick could balance the equation by altering which numbers are subtracted.
matchstick.example: Moving the '-' sign's horizontal stick to a random location that does not form a valid operator or numeral.

matchstick.title: When converting - to +, also move a vertical stick to form a valid plus sign
matchstick.principle: If you need to change a minus sign into a plus sign, you must also relocate a vertical stick from somewhere else to complete the plus sign.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a '-' must become '+' to fix the equation; ensure you supply the missing vertical stick.
matchstick.example: Changing '-' to '+' by adding a horizontal stick but forgetting to add the required vertical stick, resulting in an incomplete plus sign.

matchstick.description: Moving a stick from a numeral that cannot lose a stick without becoming invalid (e.g., X, V)
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model focuses on achieving the needed numeric change and overlooks the structural integrity of the source numeral, leading to illegal transformations.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Only relocate sticks from characters that can lose a stick while remaining a valid numeral or operator (e.g., I, the vertical part of '+', the horizontal part of '-') and verify that the source character stays valid after the move.

matchstick.description: Moving a stick from the equality sign
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may treat the '=' sign as a regular collection of sticks and forget the rule that it must stay unchanged.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Never select any stick belonging to the '=' sign for relocation; treat the equality operator as immutable.

matchstick.description: Providing an incomplete equation after moving a stick
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model sometimes removes an operator or numeral without replacing it, leaving the expression syntactically incomplete.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: After moving a stick, ensure the resulting string still contains a complete left side, an '=', and a complete right side with valid Roman numerals and operators.

matchstick.description: Changing – to + without adding the required vertical stick (resulting in an incomplete plus sign)
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model adds the horizontal component of a plus sign but forgets that a plus also needs a vertical stick.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: When converting a minus to a plus, always supply both the existing horizontal stick and an additional vertical stick from elsewhere.

matchstick.description: Using an angled stick as a vertical stick (or vice versa), creating an invalid numeral or operator
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may treat any stick as interchangeable, ignoring the orientation constraints of Roman numerals and operators.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Respect stick orientations: only use vertical sticks for I or the vertical part of '+', and only use diagonal sticks for V and X; never substitute one orientation for another.
